cohort: The participants were 148 Polish women aged 35 or older at childbirth, up to 12 months postpartum.
finding: Among multiparous women aged 35 and older, higher birth satisfaction and perceived social support were positively associated with more favorable breastfeeding attitudes, with birth satisfaction being the only significant predictor in a regression model.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was included as a control variable but was not a significant predictor of breastfeeding attitudes.
